title: Math Inquirers Level 1 term-time lesson (schema_version 1)
description: One lesson = one JSON file in term/l1/lessons/lNN.json. tools/validate.py enforces the rules that JSON Schema cannot (timing sums, slide/script links, wording, answers). Line kinds in script: SAY READ ASK DO SLIDE WORK HOLD MOVE REC (timed), STUCK NOTE (untimed). Block types in slides: chip p list card visual qs answers say cols table numrow answer lookback.

contest_moves.description: tutor-only; these sit at Think harder, never Start here

contest_where.description: optional; where the contest-style moves sit, printed in the guide ('Used at ...'); default 'Think harder only'. Example: 'Think harder and Go further'

ruler.description: true only if the child has a printed or real ruler at home

kit_contract.description: kit pieces printed against the most any task uses; the validator fails when supplied < max_used

parts.description: contiguous, from 0, summing to exactly 90, last part is flex (>= 4 min)

skip_order.description: optional: what to skip first if the tutor is more than 2 minutes behind at the start of the workbook

sneak_peek.description: q1 is an access question (objects, drawing or counting); q2 a thinking question

no_record.description: optional; true on a slide the tutor must not record (the check sheet): the guide lists it under Recording cues and deck.json carries it in no_record. Optional lesson field rec_pause_say gives the line to say.

start.description: 5 to 8 questions on workbook pages 1 and 2; core, approachable, untaught or just explored

think.description: 3 to 5; a taught idea in a new setting; contest-style moves live here

investigation.description: optional fields: visual / visuals (printed under the first task), draw (true or a number of drawing boxes; default: a box is added when the task says draw or sketch)

online_practice.description: items are in the practice/ runner format (type number|choice|multi|set|selfcheck; tier core|stretch|challenge; slips; tpl with vars, derive, answer using + - * // % ( ) only; a pure a//b must be the whole expression)

parent.description: also optional: quote (the one-line big idea shown on the parent page; default big_idea) | next_materials: list or string of what the NEXT lesson needs (Parent Summary 'Have ready for next lesson')

spare_time.description: If the class is ahead: 2-3 optional whole-class activities (3-5 min each; tutor line, rec cue, answer); never added to the 90-minute sum

workbook.description: optional. header (strand line at the top of every page; default '<strand>: <big idea>'), hint_p1, hint_p3, hint_p4 (intro lines; generic defaults), kits: [] for no kit page or a list of kit pages {type: base_ten|hundred_square|number_strip|cards|shapes|number_line, title, intro, width (% of page), plus type fields: number_strip {start,end}; cards {labels:[..],cols,w,h,round}; shapes {shapes:[{kind:circle|square|rect|triangle,color,n}],size}; number_line {start,end,step,...}}. If kits is absent the legacy tens-bars page is printed. | hint_p2: intro line on page 2 | kits types added in Term 2: ten_frame, groups_mat, unit_strips, array_mat, people (see AUTHORING.md) | kits types added in Terms 3-4: clock_kit, play_money {page:1|2}, price_tags, grid_tiles, mistake_cards, fold_shapes, shape_pieces, pair_cards, grid_mat, graph_mat, tool_cards, event_cards, stick_strips, calendar_cards

limits.description: optional reading-load limits for the validator warning: max_child_words (default 40), max_parent_words (default 90)

stub.description: true for a lesson file that only exercises the template (not a real lesson)

where.description: workbook question ids at Think harder or Go further

text.description: tutor-only: what goes past Primary 1 and why it is original

parent.description: optional sentence for the parent page

beyond.description: Terms 3 and 4 (any lesson may carry it): the tutor-only beyond-P1 field. Never in Start here.

text.description: REC lines may be @rec = the part rec.say

resp.description: ASK: seconds for children to answer (default 30)

draw.description: true = one drawing box; an integer = that many small boxes

choices.description: words printed for the child to circle (for example Yes and No); detected automatically from 'Circle Yes or No.', 'Circle Right or Wrong.' and 'Circle/Tick True or False.'; a part may have its own choices

draw_strokes.description: estimated strokes the child must draw (validator warns above 25); estimated from the text if absent

parts_note.description: part labels print as (a), (b); blanks: __ short, ___ standard, ____.._______ longer, [] box

visuals.description: two or more figures side by side in one question

tf.description: [{s: statement, ans: 'T'|'F'}] printed as a Statement / True / False tick table

mcq.description: {options:[..], bracket:true}: options (1) to (4) with a bracket at the right margin; the key lists the answer

steps.description: labels printed before ruled lines (for example Step 1, Step 2)

visual.description: figure types usable in slides and questions: bundles {tens,ones,table,label,style:sticks|kit}, scatter {n,seed}, ten_frame {filled,extra}, ten_to_bundle, hundred_square {blank}, number_line {start,end,step,label_every,marks,hide,jumps:[[from,to,'+10']],highlight} | ruler {start:0,end:15,objects:[{label,from,to,color}],mark} (cm ruler strip, TRUE 1:1 scale on paper: 10 cm = 100 mm; 0 at the start; an object whose from is not 0 is a shifted start; not a cut-out) | Term 2: objects, groups, array, line_up, round_table, bar_model, table, picture_equation, ten_frame with filled:[red,yellow], domino | Terms 3-4: clock {h,m,hide_hands,labels:all|quarters|none,digital,ampm,sector:[from_min,to_min],mirror}, money {items:[{v:'5c|10c|20c|50c|$1|$2|$5|$10|$50',n}],total,label,per_row}, price_tag {item,price,hide_price}, calendar {start,days,highlight,hide,mark,week}, stick_pattern {shape:triangle|square,n,hide_last,label_each}, shapes2d {shape:circle|half_circle|quarter_circle|square|rectangle|triangle,parts:1|2|4,shade,fold:v|h,compose:house|boat,label}, grid {rows,cols,kind:dots|squares,poly,route,start,end,squares,counts,mirror,mark}, cube_stack {heights,mode:iso|top|views}, fold_punch {stage:paper|folded|unfolded,fold:v|h|quarter,holes}, panel {tiles:[{shape,n,size,colour,pattern,turn}],cols,hide,labels}, network {n,lines|all,labels,count}, picture_graph {rows:[{label,n,hide}],icon,each,title,orient:rows|cols,tally,key}; number_line also takes labels {tick:text}, prefix, suffix; all take size s|m|l|percent; icons batch 2: sun moon bed bus house school shop bath rubber ruler glue shell spoon sock shoe button t_strip t_table t_list t_draw t_back t_find t_steps
